question.question: What is Vagabond Aid cost and target, is a crafted item required, and how are repeated Aid relationship improvements counted?

expected.expected_answer: Exhaust any ready undamaged item, give matching clearing card to player with faction pieces there. May take crafted item if present, but Aid can occur without item. For non-hostile faction meet printed Aid count within same turn per step, each Aid counts once toward one improvement; advance and score new space.

source_passages.quotation: - **Aid:** Exhaust **one face-up, undamaged item of any type**, give a card matching your clearing to player with faction pieces there, even Hostile. May then take one item from their Crafted Items box face up into Satchel/track; no available item is required to Aid. **Only non-Hostile relationships can advance through Aid; a Hostile recipient stays Hostile.** Check relationship improvement below.

**Relationships:** Each other faction starts Indifferent. To advance a non-Hostile marker one space, Aid that faction as many times **in this same turn** as printed between current and next spaces. One Aid counts toward only one improvement. Advance and score VP printed in new space. At final space become **Allied**; each subsequent Aid to that faction scores **two VP**.

answer.ruling: Exhaust one face-up, undamaged item of any type, then give a card matching the Vagabond's clearing to a player who has faction pieces there. The target may be Hostile. The Vagabond may then take one item from that player's Crafted Items box face up into Satchel or a track, but having an item available is not required to Aid.

Each other faction starts Indifferent. To advance a non-Hostile marker one space, Aid that faction the number of times shown between its current and next spaces during the same turn. One Aid counts toward only one improvement; advance the marker and score the VP printed in its new space. Once Allied, each later Aid to that faction scores two VP. A Hostile recipient remains Hostile and cannot advance through Aid.
